interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility markings and potentially a pedestrian refuge island.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also helping to calm traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Installing street trees or planters would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce clear path requirements to ensure that commercial equipment like shopping carts and pallets do not obstruct the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Increase the number of street trees to provide a more robust physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint clear lane lines and parking stalls to organize traffic and narrow the perceived travel way.

interventions.title: Pavement Marking Restoration
interventions.description: Repaint center lines and parking lane markings to improve driver lane discipline and awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety, especially given the blank frontages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing to the church and residential buildings.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Increase the number of street trees and add a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Building Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Securing or replacing broken windows and encouraging the occupancy of vacant storefronts to improve the physical environment and natural surveillance.
interventions.source: NACTO Urban Street Design Guide (General Principles)
